question: Which among the following is **not** an multilateral exercise?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Hand in Hand**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Hand in Hand Exercise** is a **bilateral exercise** between **India and China**.
 
• The **8th edition** of the** India-China military exercise Hand in Hand** took place in** December 2019 (7th-20th)**.
